description.value: The Rose Garden is a free public garden in Vancouver, situated near Stanley Park and widely recognized as one of the city's most visited green spaces. Formal rose plantings make it a scenic rest stop for cyclists touring the seawall or Stanley Park loop. Admission is free and the garden is openly accessible to the public.
